verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits cleanly on one line and the spacing is fairly even, but the 'Longest Day Sale' banner has shrunk to a tiny tag in the top-right corner, so the key promo is lost. The legal line also moved above the CTA and runs over the dotted circle. B: the headline wraps and leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line. The subhead, legal text and an oversized CTA are packed tightly together, with the legal text above the button. The logo and banner split across the top with no shared alignment.
